Get land prices summarised by grid square

Source: R/land-price-grid-get.R
land_price_grid_get.Rd

Summarises the sites of land_price_get() in a year by grid square and use: the number of sites, and the median and the geometric mean of their prices. It is a summary, not an observation: use land_price_get() for the sites.

Usage

land_price_grid_get(year, grid_size = "500m")

Source

Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, National Land Numerical Information, 地価公示データ (L01): https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-L01-2026.html. The terms of use are on https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/other/agreement_01.html.

Arguments

year

Reference year, from 2007 to the latest release. See land_price_files() for the available years. To get several years, iterate over them, for example with purrr::map(): the coordinate reference system differs between releases, so bind them after making it the same.

grid_size

The size of the grid squares: one of grid_sizes(), "500m" by default. Each size is built and cached for a release on its first call, without rebuilding the others.

Value

A tibble with one row per grid square and use with at least one site:

  • year, release: As in land_price_get().

  • grid_code: The code of the grid square (see grid_code()).

  • use_code: The use of the sites, as in land_price_get(). Uses are not mixed.

  • n_points: The number of sites.

  • price_median_jpy_per_m2: The median price of the sites, in yen per square meter.

  • price_geometric_mean_jpy_per_m2: The geometric mean price of the sites, in yen per square meter.

Details

Sites cover only some grid squares, so most squares have no row, and most squares with a row have a single site, especially at 500 m. Squares are not filled in. Prices are skewed, so the geometric mean (the exponential of the mean of log prices) is given rather than the arithmetic mean.

See also

land_price_grid_target() to declare the table as a target.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
land_price_grid_get(2020, "1km")

# Coarser squares, where most have several sites
land_price_grid_get(2020, "10km")
}
